shared_constraints: Show one isolated crafted object with a clear silhouette in a warm hand-illustrated workshop-book style.
No UI, text, numerals, logo, watermark, character, combat scene, guarantee, damage outcome, or copied third-party expression.
Keep the object readable at a small portrait-mobile card size and leave an uncluttered perimeter for native labels.
The raster identifies equipment only; all names, role values, controls, odds, tags, costs, and outcomes remain native Godot UI.

visual_requirements.primary_use: Let the player distinguish the first iron sword before forging and recognize the same selected workpiece at the Workshop.
visual_requirements.state_family_requirement: One neutral pristine-object identity state; damage and enhancement state remain separate native or durability-atlas presentation.
visual_requirements.brief_focus: A forged iron longsword resting diagonally on a worn oak workbench, restrained forge glow, paper-and-ink illustrated workshop-book material study.
